name: Karlov Cathedral
description: The Orzhov cathedral where Teysa's funeral is held.

description_citations.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
description_citations.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya arrives at Karlov Cathedral, prepared for Teysa's funeral.
timeline.quote: Kaya's carriage let her off in front of a cathedral dressed to the nines

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft and Etrata reveal they summoned Kaya.
timeline.quote: It's fine, Etrata. We invited her.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft tells Kaya the killers are controlled by an outside force.
timeline.quote: The killers are being controlled by an outside force.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya confesses she found a Phyrexian-script note on Teysa's body.
timeline.quote: A note, in her own hand, but not her own language. It was written in Phyrexian.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Proft announces he knows who is responsible and asks Kaya to arrange a gathering.
timeline.quote: I know who's responsible for this

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 7: Rot before Recovery" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Three days later Teysa's funeral is held at Karlov Cathedral, and her ghost sits beside Kaya.
timeline.quote: Three days later, Kaya sat in a pew at Karlov Cathedral

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa's ghost tells Kaya she keeps leading the Syndicate in death and that it was she who helped in the fight at Vitu-Ghazi.
timeline.quote: Why would a little thing like death stop me from running the Syndicate?

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Teysa explains she will ruin Selesnya financially rather than use the law, and asks Kaya to leave Ravnica.
timeline.quote: You'll have to leave, of course.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.

timeline.summary: Kaya embraces her friend Teysa, who hugs her back.

citation.work: Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay
citation.text: "Murders at Karlov Manor | Episode 10: Roots of Decay" by Seanan McGuire. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Jan 2024.
